arguments.command: cd /workspace/project && sed -i 's/^from .ast import (Alias, Bool, Char, Enum, Int, String, Struct, Void, underlying,$/from .ast import (Alias, Array, Bool, Char, Enum, Int, String, Struct, Void,\n                  underlying, int_width)/' src/eywa/oracles.py && head -16 src/eywa/oracles.py && python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); import eywa.oracles" && for t in t_plan t_run t_ident t_ident2 t_pipe t_state t_invalid t_priority t_types t_pred t_result t_edge; do python3 /workspace/tmp/$t.py >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "OK $t" || echo "FAIL $t"; done
